title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD IT UNLESS YOU WANT TO PAY FOR EVERYTHING
content: I downloaded this app and the first thing I saw was a “premium subscription” I said yeah that’s normal, then when I started browsing through this, I got to the part where you have to link your gig apps(dd,uber,xx) to see your real miles and earnings, and bum, more subscriptions on top of the first subscription they make you pay, don’t waste your time, there are better options on the market..
author: karxi

title: Just awful
content: This app is not ready for market I signed up for the premium access plan and it doesn’t register earnings or trips like it advertises just miles if you purchase the added package. I use it to determine trip earnings but 4 days in it’s been erratic and saying outrageous amounts per hour amounts like $73, $122 per hour completely inaccurate. There’s no customer service of any kind emailed them no response chat via app nothing as well even tagged them on comments  multiple times on their instagram post and finally dm him and nothing I gave it a couple days but ignoring the customer seems like the protocol and that’s why I gave it a 1 star what’s a product without someone standing behind it. Good idea but not close to being ready and  lack of professionalism is was the last straw.
